description: This file defines a template class 'TextStreamRedirectType' within the 'Thunder::Core' namespace. It includes nested classes for reading and redirecting text streams, with platform-specific implementations for Windows and non-Windows systems. The class manages stream redirection, buffer processing, and output formatting, and exposes methods to open, close, and format the stream.

classes.name: TextStreamRedirectType
classes.description: A template class that manages redirection of text streams, including platform-specific implementations for Windows and other systems. It provides methods to open, close, and format the stream, and contains nested classes for reading and processing stream data.

classes.name: Reader
classes.description: Nested class within 'TextStreamRedirectType' responsible for buffering and processing input data, detecting line terminations, and outputting processed data.

classes.name: ReaderImplementation
classes.description: Platform-specific nested class within 'TextStreamRedirectType' that handles low-level stream resource management, including opening, closing, reading, and canceling I/O operations.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the stream resource for reading and redirection.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the stream resource and restores original state.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Formats a string with variable arguments and writes it to the stream.

methods.name: Output
methods.description: Outputs buffered data to the underlying stream.
